card.name: Words just before a good-quality word
card.fires_on: Ordinary linking or verb words (remained, to, have, is, very) where the next word is likely a positive quality term like excellent, better, or well. Setting is general web prose, not tied to drug labels.

modes.label: Verb before quality word
modes.description: A verb or auxiliary right before an expected adjective or adverb of quality.
modes.example: its mobility<< remained>> excellent, far superior to the active T

modes.label: Infinitive or helper before a goal
modes.description: The word to or have in a list of purposes or goals, before a positive outcome.
modes.example: - to<< have>> fun, relax or encourage creativity.

card.writes: It pushes words meaning perfect or ideal and pushes down superior or inferior.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before a praise word like excellent, better or perfect.
